response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), s AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - a.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_average_share FROM s CROSS JOIN a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are those appearing in the telescopes table (grouped by telescopes.observstation); observatories with no telescopes are not included in the average share.

The average share is the unweighted mean of per-observatory shares across all observatories. The summary row averages the count, share, and excess over only observatories whose share is strictly above that mean.
